description.p: Encly is a private notes and tasks app with no account, no cloud, no ads and no network access. Your notes stay in one encrypted vault on this computer.

ul.li: Encrypted at rest: a SQLCipher (AES-256) database under a random key that only your PIN or your 12-word recovery phrase can unlock.
The device-bound half of the PIN key lives in your desktop's secret service (GNOME Keyring, KWallet).
Locks itself when the window loses focus, after you have been idle, and when the session locks or the computer sleeps.
A block editor with headings, quotes, checklists, lists and links, tags, search and tasks with priorities.
Encrypted backups to a single file that you save wherever you choose; Encly never uploads anything.
